description: This PHP source file provides various string processing functions used within the TestLink project. It includes functions for preserving spaces, converting newlines, formatting strings for HTML display, inserting href links for URLs and emails, sanitizing URLs, shortening strings, and other utility functions related to string manipulation and HTML safety.

methods.name: string_preserve_spaces_at_bol
methods.description: Preserves leading spaces or tabs at the beginning of each line in a string, converting spaces to   and tabs to four spaces.

methods.name: string_no_break
methods.description: Wraps a string in a span with class 'nowrap' if it contains spaces, to prevent line breaks.

methods.name: string_nl2br
methods.description:
Converts newlines to
tags, and fixes double newlines inside 
 tags, optionally wrapping lines at a given width.

methods.name: string_display
methods.description: Prepares a string for HTML display with href insertion and HTML escaping.

methods.name: string_display_line
methods.description: Prepares a single line string for HTML display with escaping and HTML tag restoration.

methods.name: string_display_links
methods.description: Prepares a string for HTML display and inserts href links for URLs, emails, bug references, and CVS references.

methods.name: string_display_line_links
methods.description: Prepares a single line string for HTML display with links for URLs, emails, bug references, and CVS references.

methods.name: string_rss_links
methods.description: Prepares a string for RSS display, adding links for URLs, emails, and references, with HTML escaping.

methods.name: string_email
methods.description: Escapes a string for plain text email display, removing href links.

methods.name: string_email_links
methods.description: Prepares a string for email display and adds href links for bug and CVS references.

methods.name: string_textarea
methods.description: Escapes a string for display in a textarea element.

methods.name: string_attribute
methods.description: Escapes a string for inclusion in HTML attributes.

methods.name: string_url
methods.description: Encodes a string to be safely included as a URL parameter.

methods.name: string_sanitize_url
methods.description: Sanitizes a URL, ensuring it begins with the site's path and encoding parameters.

methods.name: string_insert_hrefs
methods.description: Finds URLs and email addresses in a string and converts them into HTML anchor tags.

methods.name: string_strip_hrefs
methods.description: Removes HTML href tags from a string, returning only the URLs or email addresses.

methods.name: string_restore_valid_html_tags
methods.description: Restores valid HTML tags from their escaped equivalents based on the configuration.

methods.name: string_repeat_char
methods.description: Returns a string consisting of a specific character repeated multiple times.

methods.name: string_format_complete_date
methods.description: Formats a date string into a complete date format based on configuration.

methods.name: string_shorten
methods.description: Shortens a string to a maximum configured length, appending ellipsis if truncated.

methods.name: string_get_field_name
methods.description: Remaps specific field names to other names for sorting purposes.

methods.name: string_html_entities
methods.description: Converts special characters in a string to HTML entities.

methods.name: string_html_specialchars
methods.description: Converts special characters to HTML entities with consideration for charset support.

methods.name: string_prepare_header
methods.description: Prepares a string for inclusion in email headers by truncating at newlines or carriage returns.

methods.name: string_contains_scripting_chars
methods.description: Checks if a string contains scripting characters like < or >.

methods.name: email_regex_simple
methods.description: Provides a simple regex pattern to match most email addresses.
